entities.name: Squirrelfolk
entities.description: One of the animalfolk of Bloomburrow, notorious as necromancers and graverobbers and stewards of the life-death cycle.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: A plane inhabited by animalfolk, including squirrelfolk.

entities.name: Calamity Graveyard
entities.description: The place where squirrelfolk worship the life-death cycle.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Terrible forces of nature whose bones squirrelfolk collect and bury.

entities.name: Direshade Company
entities.description: A company of mercenaries led by the weaselfolk Cruelclaw, which some squirrelfolk joined.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: A weaselfolk who leads the Direshade Company of mercenaries.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: A plane whose squirrels are known as scurrids.

events.summary: Some squirrelfolk joined the Direshade Company of mercenaries under Cruelclaw.
